purpose: 2×2 reconciliation audit for the 19.04% vs 6.19% C2_vs_B1 QLIKE gap between the sealed Track A liquidation expansion (TRACKA-HL-EXPANSION-20261111T195500Z, PASS, +19.04% QLIKE rel reduction) and its independent recompute (FCLR-LIQ-EXPANSION-RECOMPUTE-20261114T073346Z, INCONCLUSIVE, +6.19% QLIKE rel reduction). Both share 1,472 (coin, ts) keys over 2026-05-01..2026-10-31. Cells: {Sealed panel, Recompute panel} × {Sealed estimator, Recompute estimator}. Verdict in {EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR, EXPLAINED_BY_DATA, UNEXPLAINED, INCONCLUSIVE}. All results EXPLORATORY_ONLY, promotable=false. Does not reopen sealed verdict.

target.name: next_24h_observed_liquidation_intensity
target.definition: next-24h observed ironflow liquidation intensity per symbol per 24h UTC bucket: sum(notional_usd) of observed liquidation events over t+1..t+24h, strictly forward from decision time t

label.name: observed_liquidation_intensity
label.definition: sum(notional_usd) of observed Hyperliquid liquidation events per symbol per 24h UTC bucket (observed liquidations only; no modeled/proxy/synthetic)

primary_metric: paired out-of-sample QLIKE, C2 vs B1

inference.bootstrap: circular block over complete UTC days

stop_rule.on_failure: INADMISSIBLE with exact failing minima; do not relax after outcomes

verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR: Gap primarily attributable to estimator differences (same data, different estimator yields different results)
verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_DATA: Gap primarily attributable to data differences (same estimator, different panel yields different results)
verdict_rule.UNEXPLAINED: Gap persists across both dimensions; neither estimator nor data alone explains the discrepancy
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Insufficient evidence to attribute; admissibility or numerical limits prevent clean verdict
